sections.heading: Start here: the one result this kit gives you
sections.body:
This kit does one thing and does it completely: it gets you one booked listing appointment with a motivated seller this week. Not ten leads, not a marketing plan. One real appointment on your calendar.

Here is the whole path, start to finish: (1) find one motivated seller in about 5 minutes using a free public source, (2) drop them into the prebuilt tracker by filling three boxes, (3) send three ready-written messages (a text, a voicemail, an email), and (4) use the booking ask to turn the reply into a meeting. Total hands-on time is about 15 minutes. Everything you need is in the next five sections.

Who this is for: a solo or small-team residential agent who wants listings, not just buyers, and who is tired of cold-calling people who never asked to hear from them. A motivated seller is someone who has already raised their hand by putting their home up for sale themselves. You are not interrupting strangers. You are reaching out to people who are publicly trying to sell right now and who almost always still end up needing an agent.

Do this once, today. The result you want is a single line in your calendar that says: listing appointment, [name], [day], [time].

sections.heading: Step 1: Find one motivated seller in 5 minutes (no MLS)
sections.body:
You only need ONE seller to get your win, so do not build a list. Find one good one and move on. The best starting source is a For Sale By Owner (FSBO) home, because it is public, it has contact details attached, and the owner has already proven they want to sell.

Use one of these free sources, pick whichever loads fastest for you:

1. Zillow: type your zip code, then under Listing Type uncheck everything except For Sale By Owner. You now see only FSBO homes.
2. Facebook Marketplace: search your city, filter to Property For Sale, and look for posts written by the owner (not a brokerage).
3. Craigslist: open your city, go to housing, then real estate by owner, and search your zip or town name.
4. FSBO.com: enter your state and town.

Pick ONE home that meets these three thresholds, so you know it is worth your time: the home has been listed for at least 14 days (long enough that the owner is getting frustrated doing it alone), the asking price fits the price band you normally work in, and the post includes a name, phone, or email. If a home fails any of the three, skip it and pick the next one. Spend no more than 5 minutes here. Copy the owner's name, the property address, and one specific detail from the listing (for example: priced at 425k, listed 19 days, mentions a renovated kitchen). That single detail is what makes your outreach land as personal instead of spam.

sections.heading: Step 2: The prebuilt Motivated-Seller Tracker (fill three boxes)
sections.body:
This is the tool that replaces all the manual work. Recreate this one-row table in any notes app or spreadsheet, or just write it on paper. It already contains everything; you only fill the three boxes marked FILL IN. Nothing else changes.

PREBUILT TRACKER (copy this exactly):

| Field | Your entry |
| Seller name | FILL IN |
| Property address | FILL IN |
| One specific detail | FILL IN |
| Source | FSBO (already filled) |
| Touch 1 - Text | Sent? date/time |
| Touch 2 - Voicemail | Sent? date/time |
| Touch 3 - Email | Sent? date/time |
| Reply received | yes / no |
| Appointment booked | day + time |

Worked example so you can see it done:

| Seller name | Maria |
| Property address | 14 Oak Street |
| One specific detail | priced 425k, listed 19 days, renovated kitchen |
| Source | FSBO |

That is the entire setup. Three boxes. The reason this matters: in the next step the scripts pull straight from these three boxes, so once they are filled, your messages are basically already written. You are not starting from a blank page and you are not tracking anything in your head. Fill the three boxes now before you read on.

sections.heading: Step 3: Copy-paste outreach (text, voicemail, email)
sections.body:
Send all three of these within the same hour. Each one already references the three boxes from your tracker. Replace anything in [brackets] with your tracker entries and your own name, then send. Do not rewrite them. They are short on purpose; short messages from a real local agent get replied to.

TOUCH 1 - TEXT (send first):
Hi [name], I saw your home at [address] is for sale by owner. I work with buyers here in [town] and I noticed [one detail]. Are you open to me sending a couple of buyers your way, or would you rather just have someone handle the whole thing for you? - [your name]

TOUCH 2 - VOICEMAIL (call right after the text; if they pick up, great, if not leave this):
Hi [name], it is [your name], a local agent here in [town]. I just texted you about your place at [address]. I help sellers in your area, and selling on your own is a lot of work. I have a couple of ideas that could save you time. Call or text me back at [number] whenever works. Thanks.

TOUCH 3 - EMAIL (send same day if you have an email):
Subject: Your home at [address]
Hi [name], I came across your listing at [address] and noticed [one detail]. A lot of for-sale-by-owner sellers in [town] start out solo and then realize the showings, paperwork, and negotiating add up fast. I would be glad to walk you through what your home would likely sell for and how I would handle it, with no obligation. Would a quick 20-minute meeting this week be useful? - [your name], [number]

Mark each touch in your tracker as you send it. You are now done with the work. The next section is only for when they reply.

sections.heading: Step 4: The booking ask and two objection replies
sections.body:
When the seller replies at all, your only goal is to set a time. Do not pitch your services over text. Get the meeting and sell in person. Use this exact booking ask the moment they respond:

BOOKING ASK:
Great, I would rather show you than tell you. I can stop by [day] at [time] or [day] at [time], whichever is easier, and walk you through what your home should sell for and exactly how I would handle the sale. Which works?

Always offer two specific time slots, never ask open-ended when are you free. Two choices get a yes far more often than an open question. The moment they pick one, write it in the Appointment booked box of your tracker. That is your win.

Two replies for the two objections you will hear most:

Objection: I am just trying to sell it myself to save the commission.
Reply: Totally fair, and a lot of my clients started exactly there. Most found that the few weeks of showings and the price they left on the table cost more than the commission. The meeting is free and you keep selling it yourself either way. Worst case you get a free, accurate price on your home. [then repeat the two time slots]

Objection: I am not ready to talk to agents yet.
Reply: No problem, no pressure at all. Can I at least send you the recent sold prices for homes like yours on [street/area] so you are pricing it right? If it is useful, we can talk later. [if yes, you have started the relationship and can follow up in a week]

That is the complete play. One seller, one appointment, this week.

sections.heading: Why one appointment is easy and a steady stream is the real job
sections.body:
If you worked through this kit, you just proved something: getting a single listing appointment is not hard. The motivated sellers are out there, they are public, and a few personal messages book a meeting.

Here is the honest catch. One appointment is easy. A predictable appointment every single week is a different job. To keep this flow going you would need to check the FSBO sources every day, catch new expired and for-sale-by-owner homes the hour they appear, add estate and probate sources, send and track every follow-up touch, qualify who is actually serious, and never let a day slip, because the agent who reaches a motivated seller first usually wins the listing. Do that on top of showings, closings, and your existing clients and it quietly becomes a full-time role you do not have time for.

That is exactly what we do at Aureon Global, and only in your own zip code. We set up a branded Home Value page in your name, seed it with the for-sale-by-owner, expired, estate, and probate sellers already in your area, reach out and qualify them on your behalf, and book the listing appointments straight onto your calendar. You just show up and take the appointment. We run it as a 3-month test with no big upfront commitment, so you get the leads and booked appointments the whole time and we earn the right to work with the next agent.

You have seen that this works at a scale of one. If you want it running continuously in your zip, reply SELLERS and I will show you how the test works.
